name: Liese Ashcroft
original_name: リーゼ・アシュクロフト
source:
A quiet servant of the Forgan family.
Since the other servants have all been dismissed, she alone takes care of the three sisters’ daily needs.

[b]“The work is only basic cleaning and preparing meals, so it’s not all that difficult.”[/b]
